entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of spell 'To Don the Mantle of the Sun'
identity: The sun is light and heat, filling the sky and providing life to the earth below, and the stars fear it and hide from its light.  This charm allows you to imitate the sun, subduing all lesser fires and causing them to flee for places safer.

identity:
The quality of this footage is both choppy and filled with the background fluctuations of static, with the view being angled upwards through the shattered beams of what used to have been a roof.  The structure looks as though it's been the recipient of a mortar bombardment, with large swaths of the roiling gray sky visible through the gaps and stifling volumes of heavy fog rolling in over the edges.  Unsteadily zooming past the wreckage, the camera focuses on the distant profile of a helicopter raveled in the depths of the filth-tinged clouds, the drone of its rotors audible as the aircraft beats its way through the bank of fog.  In the airspace around the machine, you can vaguely detect bands of ebony black undulating through the clouds—strands of oily darkness waning and fattening about its fuselage like writhing sea serpents.

Just as you fancy that the tendrils were bulging into outlines, shadowy limbs extending from them, and, for a split second, appearing like suspended ranks of unnaturally lanky figures, the whole view devolves into the screech of static.  It takes you a moment to realize that what you originally took to be the shriek of interference was actually just the video's audio.

For the last 45 seconds, it transmits the distant sounds of many hundreds of nearing, drawn-out screams.

identity:
hunternetvulfgar.mp4
The video cuts in as a montage of school security cameras in hallways, as a young man and woman break into the school.  As they walk past each camera, that image drops and the others rearrange larger, while a popular song from the 90's begins playing.  The young adults enter a classroom and are clearly flirting.
Awoo oooh, got you where I want you
plays over top of the video.  The man laughs at something the woman says, and throws his head back laughing while she is clearly annoyed.  His face elongates as his body grows, shredding the clothes he is wearing as limbs change and sprout thick fur.  She has backed away from him and put the students' and teacher's desks between them.  Fully transformed into a hideous wolfman, he begins his approach towards his once date now prey, smashing chairs and students' desks out of his way.  Suddenly the wolfcreature pauses and its ears prick up.  It turns and looks at the wall of windows in the classroom.  Glass erupts into the room as the darkness outside the window shows the muzzle flare of at least a dozen different guns firing.  The wolfcreature is hit more times than you can count in a span of seconds and falls to the ground.
The song reaches a crescendo 'Got you where I want you, got you, yeahhhhh!' as his date pulls a large caliber pistol out of the teachers desk, walks over to the fallen beast and calmly puts three bullets in its skull.  The video ends.
